terraform.description: Bump the locked provider version while it still satisfies the ~> constraint, widen the constraint only for majors

customManagers.description: Version-pinned container images of Azure web apps (e.g. Ghost)

packageRules.description: Flake inputs are updated together by the weekly lock file maintenance
Ship our own bots as soon as they change
NixOS release upgrades (e.g. nixos-26.05 -> nixos-26.11) need a human
Third-party container image (Ghost, Vaultwarden, Gatus) minor/patch updates go out weekly once CI is green; majors need a human
Provider updates get their own PR below instead of riding along in the flake.lock maintenance PR

Terraform provider minor/patch updates are grouped weekly and automerged once terraform plan is green; majors need a human. terraform.yml requires an empty plan on this group's branch (renovate/terraform-providers)
hetzner/ is applied by hand and CI never plans it, so its updates need a human
